title: とおりゃんせ (Toryanse)
description: An Edo-period children's game song about seeking passage through a narrow shrine path for a child's Shichigosan ceremony. Two children form an arch while others pass through singing. The haunting final verse — 'going is fine, returning is frightening' — has fascinated Japanese children for centuries.
license: Public Domain (Traditional Japanese warabe-uta, Edo period)
